answer_1.quote: We propose PerceptiveAgent, an empathetic multi-modal dialogue system capable of identifying the speaker's true intentions through audio modality perception and generating empathetic speech.
answer_1.outputs: PerceptiveAgent generates empathetic dialogue responses and synthesizes expressive speech outputs based on multi-modal input, including acoustic and textual information.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of dialogue text generation, we employ the BERTScore automatic evaluation metric... Classification accuracy is used to measure the performance.

answer_3.quote: Emotional and prosodic labels are recognized from response captions by sentence classifiers, accomplished with GPT-3.5-Turbo in this work, while the speaker label is randomly selected.
